coverage_note: Existing local mall extracts contain 1,185 F&B-marked tenant records across mall directories; all had at least a loose textual SFA catalogue match in initial broad comparison, but strict exact-identity comparison reveals stale/changed listings and catalog name variation. Directory tenant lists cannot establish all F&B licensed premises are represented, and SFA licensing scope itself excludes some edge cases; no new candidate with both exact identity and independent current SFA evidence was found in this bounded audit.
method: Matched official store identity to workbook by normalized outlet name and exact unit/address where available; excluded category/search landing pages and non-F&B entries. Tested 313 current directory plus exact blank-name SFA rows at postal 238895; contextual exact current official outlet pages and SFA licence/operator evidence were required. Existing VivoCity/Wisma/combined mall JSON were treated as leads, not proof of current operation.
not_in_scope: No changes to workbook; no full nationwide mall-by-mall and hawker-centre tenant audit; no Mapbox calls; no paid services.
